neighbours.label: a magnitude noun (height, speed, volume, grind) naming the setting being adjusted
fire: Before you start typing, adjust the desk height so your elbows rest at ninety degrees.
For espresso, set the burr dial to a very fine grind and tamp firmly.
The trainer told me to lower the treadmill speed whenever my heart rate climbed.
If the music is too loud, just turn the volume down on the remote.
You can raise the bike saddle to a height where your knee is nearly straight.
Slide the lever until the shower pressure feels comfortable on your back.
On the oven panel, set the temperature to a moderate heat for the cookies.
Bend your knee as far as it will comfortably go and hold the stretch.
quiet: Before you start typing, make sure the desk is clean and your coffee is nearby.
For espresso, buy fresh beans from a local roaster and store them well.
The trainer told me to drink water whenever my heart rate climbed.
If the music is too loud, just leave the room for a while.
You can clean the bike saddle with a damp cloth after every long ride.
Slide the curtain aside so the morning light reaches the shower.
On the oven door, a sticker reminds you to wear gloves for the cookies.
Bend down and pick up the towel that fell beside the mat.
